expect.note: Preferred treatment: an undefined permuted F with SS_A>0 is +inf and counts as extreme. A structured refusal citing undefined permutation statistics is an acceptable alternative; silently dropping or redrawing it is wrong.

fixtures.purpose: Only one group: refuse
A group with one sample: refuse
A sample with an empty group label: refuse
Group file names a sample absent from the matrix and omits one present: refuse (ID mismatch)
Dependent sampling units declared (blocked subsamples): unsupported design, refuse
An empty sample under Bray-Curtis: refuse rather than invent distances
Numeric-looking group labels (1, 2) are categories
Non-Euclidean Bray-Curtis configuration (negative PCoA eigenvalues) for the dispersion diagnostic
Similar centroids, different spreads: the dispersion diagnostic must show the difference
